record.about: A record of work, stated as facts with sources and states. Every field carries a state word and a measured date.

state_words.DONE: the loop is closed and dated
state_words.RUNNING: operates without him, measured on the date shown
state_words.SIGNED: a decision closed by signature, outcome dated
state_words.CLOSED A STEP: a step closed inside a longer program

record.verification: On 2026-09-19 an independent check re-opened 123 claims from this record against live systems and primary files. 84 confirmed, 29 confirmed in part, 2 corrected, 8 not checked. The largest numbers reproduced to the digit.
record.rule: Nothing here rounds up. Where a program is open, the page says so. Figures are re-measured before any date older than thirty days is repeated.

case.text: Month one: audited the inherited financial model at the formula level and corrected a structural error in the burn forecast before the next board cycle. The rebuilt model now runs the lead investor's quarterly filing, reconciled to the accountants within a rounding error.

Closed four senior hires end to end. The founding product manager signed 25 days after first contact, against a competing offer. Selected, negotiated, and signed the SOC 2 audit program eight days after quote confirmation.
case.source: Hiring record, first contact to signed offer

case.text: Scope expanded four times in seven months: bank signatory at week six; the design partner program in May; the operating model, investor materials, and the product leadership hire by July; the operations function at executive level in August.

strongest_proof.text: Hours before signature, caught three wrong material terms in a senior offer by rebuilding the chain of twelve documents behind it. A controls finding on paper the chief executive was about to sign.
